ask.again.on.the.next.app.launch.if.star: Ask again on the next app launch if startup checks are enabled.

Auto chooses the faster supported route. Full mesh keeps all geometry together. Tiled processing divides a mesh into bounded pieces for parallel CPU work.
auto.scales.gap.bridging.to.the.mesh.man: Auto scales gap bridging to the mesh. Manual zero leaves bridging off. Missing scan regions remain unknown space.
auto.scales.the.clamshell.wall.to.the.me: Auto scales the clamshell wall to the mesh. Drag the slider to set a manual thickness.
automatic.checks.the.current.memory.budg: Automatic checks the current memory budget at load time. Full mesh overrides that check and can exhaust memory. Tiled processing keeps full-resolution geometry in bounded disk-backed tiles and can use multiple CPU workers. Overview only opens a lighter navigation copy and leaves editing disabled.
automatic.target.density.draft.15.balanc: Automatic target density: Draft 15%, Balanced 50%, Fine 75% maximum.
automatic.uses.tiled.processing.only.whe: Automatic uses tiled processing only when index setup plus tiled reduction is estimated to be faster than full-mesh reduction for the selected algorithm.
average.shape.error.sampled.distance.fro: Average shape error: sampled distance from the original mesh to the result, shown as a percentage of the model diagonal. Lower preserves the overall surface better. A very low average can still hide isolated damaged areas, so compare it with P95.
binary.stl.size.of.the.pending.result.or: Binary STL size of the pending result, or an estimate for the optimization target.
boundary.edges.remaining.in.the.solidifi: Boundary edges remaining in the solidified region. Zero means no open borders; the Solidify operation also validates intersections and topology before returning a result.
cancel.this.operation.and.restore.the.pr: Cancel this operation and restore the preceding mesh, selection, and settings.
changes.meshmill.window.colors.panel.con: Changes MeshMill window colors, panel contrast, and controls. It does not change tools, layout, or mesh behavior.
check.github.once.for.a.newer.meshmill.r: Check GitHub once for a newer MeshMill release. This does not change the automatic setting.

choose.a.free.viewport.corner.for.this.o: Choose a free viewport corner for this overlay.

choose.how.mesh.geometry.and.point.densi: Choose how mesh geometry and point density are drawn.
choose.shaded.wireframe.point.or.color.m: Choose shaded, wireframe, point, or color-mapped point-density display.
choose.the.smart.quality.setting.selecte: Choose the Smart quality setting selected when MeshMill opens. Draft removes more geometry, Balanced is the middle setting, and Fine preserves more detail.
choose.the.algorithm.selected.when.meshm: Choose the algorithm selected when MeshMill opens. Last used remembers your most recent choice. Automatic selects Depth + Density Adaptive QEM when its GPU backend is available and Density balanced otherwise.

choose.the.units.used.for.ruler.distance: Choose the units used for ruler distances.
choose.which.side.of.the.window.contains: Choose which side of the window contains the tools pane.
clamshell.creates.a.hollow.housing.aroun: Clamshell creates a hollow housing around the mesh, with an optional split. Envelope creates only the offset outer surface.
Click a known exterior surface to guide detection of its continuous surface sheet. Add picks where an incomplete scan is detected incorrectly.
click.to.check.github.for.a.newer.meshmi: Click to check GitHub for a newer MeshMill release. Right-click to copy the installed version. This does not enable automatic checks.
Combined length of open borders. This is perimeter, not missing area or wall thickness. The completed preview reports how much surface was rebuilt.
copy.the.full.stl.path.to.the.clipboard: Copy the full STL path to the clipboard.
create.a.solid.preview.for.the.selection: Create a solid preview for the selection, or for the whole mesh when nothing is selected.
create.an.cast.preview.using.the.current: Create an cast preview using the current settings.
create.an.optimization.preview.using.the: Create an optimization preview using the current settings.
current.workspace.mesh.inside.the.axis.c: Current workspace mesh inside the axis cube. Solid edges face the camera; dashed edges are behind. The miniature follows camera rotation and saved-axis changes.

diagnostics.are.optional.and.editable.fi: Diagnostics are optional and editable. File paths, account information, and hardware identifiers are not collected.
discard.the.pending.preview.and.keep.the: Discard the pending preview and keep the working mesh.
download.and.verify.the.update.then.inst: Download and verify the update, then install it and reopen the current STL. Save changes and finish or cancel the current operation first.
download.verify.and.install.updates.with: Download, verify, and install updates without another confirmation when MeshMill is idle and the mesh has no unsaved changes. Reopens the current STL after updating. Requires startup update checking; no separate background service is installed.
Drag corners to edit the selection. Ctrl+drag adds another region. Shift+click measures.
drag.in.the.viewport.to.turn.the.plane.d: Drag in the viewport to turn the plane. Drag around the edge to roll it clockwise or counterclockwise.
drag.sections.or.use.move.up.and.move.do: Drag sections or use Move up and Move down. Active tool follows the expanded tool; Other tools contains the collapsed tools.
drag.the.plane.along.its.normal: Drag the plane along its normal.
edit.the.commands.before.copying.or.savi: Edit the commands before copying or saving the script.
estimated.binary.stl.file.size.not.memor: Estimated binary STL file size, not memory usage.
estimated.from.currently.available.memor: Estimated from currently available memory, the configured memory budget, CPU count, and overview chunk size. Geometry operations currently run one at a time.
export.the.preview.without.replacing.the: Export the preview without replacing the working mesh.
fast.qem.works.on.every.supported.system: Fast QEM works on every supported system. Depth Adaptive QEM uses its bundled NVIDIA CUDA runtime to measure the surface before reduction and can preserve more shape detail. Depth + Density Adaptive QEM adds density- and normal-weighted reduction plus bounded surface finishing for the highest measured quality, with a longer runtime. GPU-guided algorithms are available when MeshMill detects compatible NVIDIA hardware.
fill.missing.geometry.while.preserving.m: Fill missing geometry while preserving measured surfaces; validate the completed solid before applying it.
fill.missing.scan.geometry.before.buildi: Fill missing scan geometry before building the clamshell. Closed solids skip this step.
finish.the.current.operation.before.load: Finish the current operation before loading another mesh.
five.fixed.interface.sizes.system.defaul: Five fixed interface sizes. System default is the second position. The toolbox widens with larger text so controls and descriptions stay readable.
gnu.general.public.license.v3.0.or.later: GNU General Public License v3.0 or later.
generate.an.optimization.preview.using.t: Generate an optimization preview using the current settings.
geometry.optimization.method.used.for.th: Geometry optimization method used for the next operation.
high.end.shape.error.95.of.sampled.origi: High-end shape error: 95% of sampled original points are within this distance of the result, shown as a percentage of the model diagonal. Lower is better. This reveals localized damage that the average error can hide.
how.long.cpu.and.gpu.readings.stay.avail: How long CPU and GPU readings stay available. Recent readings are shown in detail; older readings are grouped into averages with their minimum and peak usage preserved.
how.often.meshmill.samples.cpu.gpu.ram.v: How often MeshMill samples CPU, GPU, RAM, VRAM, and I/O. Faster updates make the graph smoother but retain more samples.
includes.meshmill.version.broad.operatin: Includes MeshMill version, broad operating-system information, capability status, and selected MeshMill options. It excludes paths, usernames, device names, hardware identifiers, driver details, and raw settings files.
inspect.reduce.solidify.and.cast.stl.mes: Inspect, reduce, solidify, and cast STL meshes.
its.runtime.is.included.with.meshmill.bu: Its runtime is included with MeshMill, but the algorithm requires a compatible NVIDIA GPU and driver. MeshMill will use Density balanced instead.
left.coarser.and.faster.right.finer.deta: Left: coarser and faster. Right: finer detail. Actual resolution adapts to available memory.
left.completed.jobs.and.total.processing: Left: completed jobs and total processing time for this session. Right: the most recent operation and time spent in its main stages. CPU/GPU totals count geometry inputs processed by each analysis or reduction pass, including repeated previews. Bytes are point and triangle array sizes, not file sizes, memory usage, or transfer traffic. A mesh processed on both devices contributes to both totals. Cached results do not add another pass. Totals reset when the app closes.
live.target.from.the.optimization.slider: Live target from the optimization slider. The optimizer may finish a few triangles above or below this value when preserving valid geometry requires it.
maintenance.installs.patch.updates.withi: Maintenance installs patch updates within the same release series, such as 0.3.2 to 0.3.3. Updates to 0.4.0 or 1.0.0 still ask first. All releases also allows minor and major upgrades. Preview releases are excluded.
measuring.open.boundaries.in.the.current: Measuring open boundaries in the current mesh or selection.
move.the.split.plane.to.the.model.center: Move the split plane to the model center, keeping its angle.
nvidia.utilization.for.the.selected.geom: NVIDIA utilization for the selected geometry GPU. Windows rendering-engine counters are unavailable; viewport activity may use another adapter.
open.windows.default.app.settings.to.cho: Open Windows default-app settings to choose the app for .stl files. Installing MeshMill adds Open With without replacing your current default. No default changes until you choose one in Windows.
open.the.folder.containing.this.stl: Open the folder containing this STL.
open.the.release.downloads.for.your.oper: Open the release downloads for your operating system.

overall.x.y.z.size.of.the.original.mesh: Overall X × Y × Z size of the original mesh.
overview.mode.is.for.navigation.load.the: Overview mode is for navigation. Load the full mesh to edit.

pick.a.surface.within.the.selected.regio: Pick a surface within the selected region.
reading.triangles.and.welding.shared.ver: Reading triangles and welding shared vertices.
recent.readings.are.detailed.on.the.righ: Recent readings are detailed on the right. Older readings are progressively grouped toward the left. Lines show sampled averages; vertical ranges preserve minimum and peak usage. Shading marks geometry processing.
regenerate.the.cast.preview.with.the.cha: Regenerate the cast preview with the changed settings before applying or saving.
reload.source.stl.and.discard.edits: Reload source STL and discard edits.
repeat.committed.optimize.solidify.and.c: Repeat committed Optimize, Solidify and Cast operations without opening the UI. Selections and crops use an edited-mesh input checkpoint.
reset.all.settings.to.defaults.after.con: Reset all settings to defaults after confirmation. Save to apply.
review.and.edit.this.text.before.creatin: Review and edit this text before creating the GitHub issue.

runs.one.github.release.check.inside.mes: Runs one GitHub release check inside MeshMill shortly after the app opens. MeshMill does not install an updater, service, scheduled task, startup item, or background process. Nothing runs while MeshMill is closed. save.the.current.mesh.as.stl.collada.glb: Save the current mesh as STL, COLLADA, GLB, OBJ or PLY.
selection.is.empty.resize.the.outline.or: Selection is empty. Resize the outline or clear it.
selection.is.too.small.to.optimize: Selection is too small to optimize.

separate.the.halves.physically.for.selec: Separate the halves physically for selection and export. Turning this off returns them to their assembled positions, where STL importers may join touching faces.
sets.how.aggressively.meshmill.derives.t: Sets how aggressively MeshMill derives the triangle target. Draft favors a smaller mesh, Balanced splits the tradeoff, and Fine preserves more detail. Changing this value updates the target immediately.
sets.how.much.currently.available.ram.me: Sets how much currently available RAM MeshMill may use when deciding whether a mesh can be loaded in full. A higher value accepts larger meshes but leaves less memory for other applications.
sets.the.viewport.background.and.its.flo: Sets the viewport background and its floating controls. Match theme uses the same palette as the rest of MeshMill.
shift.click.adds.or.removes.a.ruler.poin: Shift+click adds or removes a ruler point.
show.an.icon.beside.open.and.remember.up: Show an icon beside Open and remember up to ten successfully opened files on this computer. Off by default. Disabling clears this recent-file history.
show.more.time.in.the.metrics.graph: Show more time in the metrics graph.
show.or.hide.cpu.memory.gpu.and.mesh.met: Show or hide CPU, memory, GPU, and mesh metrics.
show.the.source.mesh.behind.the.cast.pre: Show the source mesh behind the cast preview.
size.of.the.stl.file.opened.from.disk: Size of the STL file opened from disk.

surface.area.change.how.much.total.trian: Surface-area change: how much total triangle area changed. Lower is usually better. A large value can indicate collapsed features, folded surfaces, or duplicated geometry.

switch.between.the.original.and.optimize: Switch between the original and optimized meshes.

the.recent.time.range.shown.in.full.deta: The recent time range shown in full detail on the right. Older history is progressively compressed toward the left. A shorter range zooms in and enables scrolling.
